notes.title: We just launched our new title!
notes.notes:
We just launched our new game "Ashes" and to celebrate we are giving Talewind its biggest discount ever at 85% on [u][b]Halloween[/b][/u]!!!

So if you liked Talewind or if you are just into Story heavy games please check our new title ːsteamhappyː

https://store.steampowered.com/app/904160/Ashes/

We hope to have your support on our new title as well.

notes.title: WindLimit is announcing a new game!
notes.notes:
To all the Talewind fans that stuck with us for so long i would like to announce our new game!

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355128/cffb052c63a6a6bd61180ed847bd01eef42a1f04.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355128/45f0c6bf4186fe42fa54de7b17aa696b56063fa0.png[/img][/url]

Ashes, a short first person atmospheric story inspired by games like skyrim and dear esther. If you liked Talewind and are interested in our new game you can check it on the following links:

Facebook page: https://www.facebook.com/ashesindiegame/
Official site: http://www.ashes.windlimit.net/

And to commemorate this announcement we are going to run a 80% discount on Talewind from the 12 of march to the 19, so if you were waiting for a deep discount this is your chance!


I hope we can count on your continued support on our next title :)

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355128/2a406a814b3f33aca9f8ddbb1d58f1fe4c57081b.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Explorer's Update!
notes.notes:
We decided to surprise you with another FREE UPDATE for Talewind!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355128/123ad106579c8fab28429fd55671ac4207554ff3.jpg[/img]


In this update you can explore 5 new maps that act as short cuts to complete the game faster ( if you are not a completionist ), this maps use the tile set of the standard worlds but are much shorter and harder but they have a catch, you have to find them in the second level of each world.

In this update you get:


-5 new maps
-more lore and funny bits in the new maps
-improvements to the warp room 
-5 new achievements
-steam cards and badges
-steam backgrounds

We are just waiting on the cards to be approved which shouldn't take long now.


We hope to hear your feedback, and don't forget to report any bugs ;)

notes.title: Halloween update is now live!
notes.notes:
[img][/img]Talewind: Isaac's basement is a free Halloween themed update inspired by the binding of Isaac world, you will be able to explore the secret that lies beneath our protagonist's house and know more about the world of Talewind. 

The update features: 

1 new level in a new scenario 
The history of our protagonist's grandfather 
3 new monsters 
1 new achievement

You will be able to access the new zone after you complete world 1.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26355128/8e8944d40d2fe21c154c856271d6acfa590d19ef.jpg[/img]

This is also a way to say "thank you" to all the players that supported us, we hope you enjoy the new content.


[b][u]P.S: We are already working on more free content.	[/u][/b]


Thank you,
The Talewind team.

notes.notes:

It is going to feature
-a new tile-set

-more lore

It is a way to say thank you for the people that supported us on release.

We are also working on more free content besides this one so stay tuned.

notes.title: Settings bug fixed, level design tweaks and lifes gone!
notes.notes:
Some of our reviews pointed out that the game is too frustrating, so to fix that we decided to away with lives, Rayman style.

You should also be able to fix your settings now, keep in mind if you change them in the main menu you have to either "continue" or start a new game for them to save.

We also did major tweaks in world 3 and 4 to make them more accessible.

Collectibles are now also easier to collect.

The game is now a more casual experience except for maybe the end of world 4, world 5 and the special levels.



Mac patch should be coming tomorrow.


Please let me know what you think.
